author: PH_Msus
body:
Username: PH_Msus

Reason: Hacking

Why I Should Be Unbanned: I should be unbanned because i have been banned for almost 4 months now.. The past 4 months have gave me some time to think about what i had done to get myself banned. I can assure you that i no longer hack and i will no longer be an issue to you if my appeal were to be accepted. I deleted my hacks about 2 months after i was banned, meaning i have been hack free for 2 months and counting now. Not using hacks has made me realize that it is a lot of fun playing legit and actually enjoying the servers you play and not ruin it for the others to get an advantage toward something or too have an advantage for your team to win. So i ask you out of the kindness of your heart to consider unbanning me from the server. I won't let what happened happen again. If for some reason you are unable to accept my appeal and unban me, i totally understand, i will just move on with my minecraft career and play somewhere else. Thank you for reading this appeal.

title: Ban Appeal

replies.author: DJ_Barnsey
replies.body:
Hello,

Seeing your appeal and the effort you have put into it + the amount of time you have served this punishment i've decided to appeal your ban.

Keep in mind that this is your last chance. If caught hacking again your chances of appealing will be 0.

Please read the rules.
